inputs.text: Hey, get a load of this rigged setup in Wisconsin. A jury there just nailed Harry Wait with two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft for requesting the ballots of Robin Vos and Cory Mason without their say-so. Wait leads a group that challenges the official election story, and he already admitted back in 2022 he did this specifically to expose how vulnerable the state's voter system is to manipulation. But of course the authorities are spinning it as fraud to shut him down and protect the real players behind the scenes. This smells like a coordinated hit by the elites and institutions to silence anyone sniffing around the vulnerabilities they don't want exposed, because if the system's that easy to poke, it raises all kinds of questions about who's really in control.
